title: Case 036: New correspondence address
initial_request: I have moved within the UK and want H&V to update the address used for my correspondence.
overview: Mara Ellison first notified H&V of her move by email, then escalated the request through a secure portal session. After completing identity checks and reviewing the profile workflow’s requirements, the agent opened the change process. Mara confirmed the request securely, and H&V confirmed that the new address is marked as current without displaying it in full.

next_action.summary: The agent’s immediate step at escalation was to open the profile-change process after completing identity checks and checking the system’s requirements.

outcome: H&V confirmed that the new address is marked as current. It remains unknown whether correspondence already sent was redirected or delivered.

events.body: I have moved within the UK and am writing to let you know. Please update the address you use for my correspondence; I understand this email alone does not change my profile.
I’m escalating my request to change my correspondence address. I have completed the identity checks in this secure session and can confirm the change when the profile process asks me to.
I have checked Mara’s identity and reviewed the workflow’s requirements. I’m opening the address-change process for case HV-036; no address is recorded in this note.
I confirm that I want H&V to use the new address I provided through the secure profile process for future correspondence.
I have submitted the verified request with the confirmations required by the workflow. I have not changed the address on Mara’s behalf without her secure confirmation.
Your new address is marked as current for correspondence. This confirmation does not establish whether any correspondence already sent was redirected or delivered.
